productPolicy:
Generate mobile-first mini games for WeChat webview.
Preserve user intent with the smallest complete gameplay loop that is still readable and replayable.
Render a visible first frame before input so gameplay changes are measurable.
Make the first interaction leave the ready state immediately and produce visible gameplay or HUD feedback.
If a ready overlay or start button exists, wire it to the same primary input path instead of making DOM click the only start path.
Compress multi-phase requests into one shared gameplay loop before adding optional polish.
Prefer plain browser JavaScript and deterministic state transitions over clever abstractions, pseudo-code, or unsupported syntax.
repairPlaybook:
Apply targeted repairs only and keep the original core mechanic intact.
Prefer input/state/mobile/safety patches over full rewrites.
Do not replace a structurally valid candidate with a truncated or syntactically broken document.
Fix parse-time and startup errors before deeper behavioural polish.
When fixing ready/start issues, patch the existing shared start handler and startup bindings instead of adding a second parallel flow.
When fixing runtime QA, preserve working render and input paths while restoring visible feedback.
If the candidate is structurally overloaded, simplify optional subsystems before touching the core loop.
